event_summary: A vertical blade passes through a small orange citrus piece on a cutting board, separating it into two visible pieces.
raw_event_description: At the start, a small orange citrus piece sits upright near the center of a textured transparent cutting board while a thin vertical blade is already aligned through its center. Over time the blade remains near the middle line of the fruit and advances through it. A visible split opens between the left and right portions. The right portion moves outward to the right and tilts onto the board, while the left portion remains to the left of the blade with a smaller shift. By the end, two separated citrus pieces are visible on opposite sides of the blade.

reasons: The blade is already in contact with or overlapping the citrus piece in the first frame.
The citrus piece, blade, cutting board, and tabletop are clearly visible.
The first frame does not show a fully untouched citrus piece before blade contact.
